contract:
The normative contract is the doc comment on ExchangeResult/ExchangePiece/ExchangeCapture in packages/chess-core/src/types.ts (unchanged by this diff; read it with git show fb6200f:packages/chess-core/src/types.ts).
Spoke's design choices: lists built per side by repeatedly taking the cheapest current attacker (p,n,b,r,q,k; ties by square), lifting it and re-asking chess.js attackers(); pieces not attacking on the original board are xray: true; enemy pieces never lifted. Sequence alternates until one side runs out; before a king captures it checks, on a board with all earlier capturers removed and the king lifted, whether the other side still attacks the square; if so the sequence stops. Pawn capture onto rank 8/1 promotes: gain = captured + 8, square holds a queen (9). fullResult = alternating sum; result by negamax best[i] = max(0, gain[i] - best[i+1]); on a tie the side stops (even trade -> bestLength 0, result 0). Empty square or king on the square -> empty sequence, lists still filled. Invalid square (/^[a-h][1-8]$/) or FEN -> Error. En passant ignored. EXCHANGE_CAVEAT exported.
